query:
CREATE TABLE `comments` (
	`id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
	`userId` int NOT NULL,
	`videoId` int NOT NULL,
	`content` text NOT NULL,
	`createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
	`updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
	CONSTRAINT `comments_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
);

CREATE TABLE `likes` (
	`id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
	`userId` int NOT NULL,
	`videoId` int NOT NULL,
	`createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
	CONSTRAINT `likes_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
);

CREATE TABLE `points_history` (
	`id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
	`userId` int NOT NULL,
	`points` int NOT NULL,
	`action` varchar(64) NOT NULL,
	`description` text,
	`createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
	CONSTRAINT `points_history_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
);

CREATE TABLE `spin_history` (
	`id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
	`userId` int NOT NULL,
	`pointsWon` int NOT NULL,
	`spinDate` varchar(10) NOT NULL,
	`createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
	CONSTRAINT `spin_history_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
);

CREATE TABLE `video_views` (
	`id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
	`userId` int,
	`videoId` int NOT NULL,
	`viewedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
	CONSTRAINT `video_views_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
);

CREATE TABLE `videos` (
	`id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
	`userId` int NOT NULL,
	`title` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
	`description` text,
	`videoUrl` text NOT NULL,
	`videoKey` text NOT NULL,
	`thumbnailUrl` text,
	`duration` int,
	`viewCount` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
	`likeCount` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
	`commentCount` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
	`trendScore` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
	`createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
	`updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
	CONSTRAINT `videos_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
);

ALTER TABLE `users` ADD `avatarUrl` text;
ALTER TABLE `users` ADD `bio` text;
ALTER TABLE `users` ADD `totalPoints` int DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL;
ALTER TABLE `users` ADD `level` int DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL;
